verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents an official HubSpot MCP server that gives any MCP-compatible AI tool or agent secure read and write access to CRM data such as contacts, deals and engagements. It also offers a separate CLI-based Developer MCP server for agentic development tools, and a probe confirmed the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and documented setup, auth and tool-coverage details beyond the summary statements.
